tasks.label: SDK: colcon build
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source /home/niic/wheelloong/install/setup.bash && cd /home/niic/auto_sdk_ws && colcon build --symlink-install --packages-select wheelloong_auto_sdk

tasks.label: SDK: colcon test
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source /home/niic/wheelloong/install/setup.bash && source /home/niic/auto_sdk_ws/install/setup.bash && cd /home/niic/auto_sdk_ws && colcon test --packages-select wheelloong_auto_sdk --event-handlers console_direct+ && colcon test-result --verbose
